settings.label: Start In
settings.description: Which view opens first. From the channel list, > opens the guide; from the guide, C opens the channel list.

settings.label: Video Quality
settings.description: EXTEND models only; ignored on tuners with no encoder. internet480 is 704x480, which matches a 480i CRT.

settings.label: Rescan Guide Data
settings.description: Switch on to start a guide scan (~90 min). Clears itself once the scan begins. Requires epg-rescan.path — see README.
